about: The anatomy mirror as one PosePointer configuration (app@1, web 0.2.0+). No app code: the page is one /pp/pp.js tag. input mirror-dwell (point-dwell with a speed limit of 8 so the cursor keeps up with a fast fingertip): cursor on the index fingertip, exactly where the mirror shows it (0.2.1), point to arm for 10 s, hold still 0.8 s to press, a fist disarms (chosen over dwell-fingertip by tools/app-false-clicks.mjs: 0 vs 10 presses on the no-pointing clip). cursor buttons (0.2.2): the cursor and its dwell fill show only while the fingertip is on a button; from 0.5.1 a dwell also counts only on a button, so the page never clicks anywhere else. Change input to pinch-palm-ready for pinch clicks, or cursor to hand to show it whenever a hand is seen; change looks or buttons here.
